ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 60

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 15
   D. 30

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 23
   C. 19
   D. 7

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

12. Solve for x: x + 7 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 18
   D. 11

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

14. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 13

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

17. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

18. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

19. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

20. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 50

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

22. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

24. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
